scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o dist/index.html index.html && cleancss -o dist/style.css style.css && terser script.js -c -m -o dist/script.js && cp -r photos dist/photos && cp -r audio dist/audio && cp -r vendor dist/vendor && cp -r animations dist/animations
